records.Name: Ankur Jalaria
records.Bio__c: Ankur Jaluria joined Universal McCann Worldwide (UM) in 2016, assuming positions of increasing responsibility before taking on her current role - vice president, decision sciences - in 2021. During her tenure at UM, she has supported luxury brands like American Express and BMW in their media efforts to drive awareness and sales. Prior to joining UM, Jaluria was a software developer, working at Deutsche Bank and Bank of America Merrill Lynch. With the goal of transitioning into a banking role, she earned an M.B.A. in Finance and Marketing from New York University's Stern School of Business. Later, she decided to change her path again, completing an M.S. in Marketing Intelligence at Fordham University's Gabelli School of Business and successfully launching her career in marketing analytics. Jaluria has served as an adjunct professor at the Gabelli School of Business since 2021, bringing real-world experience in marketing analytics and the unique perspective of a career changer to the classroom. Her exceptional work at the Gabelli School was recognized with the Dean's Award for Faculty Excellence.

records.Name: Anthony Lanier Caudle
records.Bio__c: Anthony Lanier Caudle has been an adjunct professor of finance at Fordham University's Gabelli School of Business since January 2018. Caudle is a senior executive with more than 25 years of domestic and international experience in the financial services industry. Prior to founding RedTail Capital Markets in 2013, he held senior executive positions at firms including American Express and Comerica Bank. At American Express, while leading its Global Strategic Planning Group, Caudle acted as a strategic advisor to various business unit presidents and to the chairman and CEO of American Express. Prior to his time with American Express, he spent 10 years with Comerica Bank, where he was the senior managing director and head of corporate investment banking. Under his leadership, Comerica Bank launched its corporate investment banking activities,, growing the investment banking business from virtually no presence in the corporate capital markets to become one of the largest super regional participating commercial banks with $350 billion in managed underwritings. Caudle received the Chairman's Circle award several years straight for his leadership in investment banking sales production. Caudle earned a B.S. in electrical engineering from Purdue University's School of Technology, an M.B.A. with a concentration in analytical finance from the University of Chicago's Booth School of Business and an M.Div. from Howard University's School of Divinity. He holds active FINRA securities licenses series 7, 24, 79, and 63, and serves on the board of the New York chapter of the Association of Corporate Growth.

records.Name: Anthony M. Palma, CAMS, CFE, CFSA
records.Bio__c: Anthony M. Palma is a member of the adjunct faculty of Fordham University's Gabelli Business School with subject matter expertise in enterprise risk assessments, crisis management, business ethics, global corporate compliance, global corporate governance, fintech compliance, investor relations, corporate communications, and business writing. Prior to joining Fordham University, Palma spent his career in corporate leadership positions at Morgan Stanley, Citigroup, JPMorgan Chase, Merrill Lynch, and Bankers Trust Company. A frequent speaker at numerous financial services industry conferences, Palma is a senior advisor to a number of corporations and is a member of the board of directors of the Fiduciary and Investment Risk Management Association and the WH Hospitality Group. He has contributed to and edited two books, The Corporate Compliance Handbook and the Corporate Legal Department Handbook. Tony is a Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS), a Certified Financial Services Auditor (CFSA) and a Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE). Palma earned a B.A. in Economics from Fordham University and an M.S. in Professional Accounting degree from Fordham University's Gabelli School of Business. He has participated in post-graduate programs at New York University, The New School, and Monmouth University.

records.Name: Brian Norris
records.Bio__c: Brian Norris is executive vice president and chief revenue officer for The E.W. Scripps Company. He is responsible for advertising revenue across all Scripps properties, including more than 60 local television stations, eight national news and entertainment networks and CTV offerings. Before joining Scripps in August 2023, Norris led NBC Universal's SMB growth division as senior vice president. In this role, he led the sales team responsible for leveraging NBCUniversal's suite of premium content and advanced advertising capabilities to assist small and medium-sized businesses scale beyond social media. Prior to that, he built NBCUniversal's first business development and sales team dedicated to the direct-to-consumer and mid-market category as senior vice president of direct-to-scale and commerce partnerships. Norris serves on the board of HyphaMetrics, a data and technology company that focuses on measuring cross-platform media consumption. Norris previously led media sales for DISH Network and Sling TV. He joined DISH in 2008 to help launch DISH Media Sales' flagship office in New York. Earlier in his career, he held sales roles with Viacom and Lifetime Entertainment Services. In addition to his tenured footprint in the media industry, Norris also serves as an adjunct professor at Fordham University's Gabelli School of Business in New York and is on the Dean's Advisory Council for The College of Fine Arts and Communication at Towson University. Norris holds a bachelor's degree in science from Towson University in Towson, Maryland, and an Executive Master of Business Administration from Brown University in Providence, Rhode Island, and IE Business School in Madrid, Spain. He is based in New York.

records.Name: Bridget Thorenson
records.Bio__c: Bridget Thoreson is a book publishing professional with nearly 15 years of experience. In addition to teaching at the Gabelli School of Business, she is the director of client publisher operations at Simon & Schuster. Prior to that, she spent a decade at independent publisher Ulysses Press, most recently as vice president of operations and marketing. Her career has spanned operations and strategy, marketing, and editorial work for indie presses as well as Big 5 publishers. In 2021, she co-founded Pacific & Court, a boutique book marketing and publicity firm.

records.Name: Carolina Villegas-Galaviz
records.Bio__c: Carolina Villegas-Galaviz currently works as a visiting research scholar at Fordham University's Gabelli School of Business, where she teaches the Business EthicsandAI Ethics. Previously, she was a postdoctoral research associate at the University of Notre Dame. Before moving to the U.S., she worked as a lecturer in the management department of ICADE (Spain) and as a research assistant at IESE Business School. She has a background in philosophy, and her research is at the intersection of business ethics and artificial intelligence ethics.She holds a Ph.D. from ICADE and was a visiting doctoral student at the Mendoza College of Business at Notre Dame. Her dissertation, "Business Ethics and Ethics of Care in Artificial Intelligence," is among the first dissertations related to AI ethics. She holds a Master's in Organizational Governance from the University of Navarra, and a B.A. in Philosophy and a B.A. in Communication from the same university. She won the Society for Business Ethics Founders Award in 2020 and 2022.

records.Name: Charles Schreger
records.Bio__c: Charles Schreger is a leading expert and innovator in the distribution of intellectual property - including feature films, television series, documentaries, reality programming and sports - to broadcasters, streaming services, and movie theaters in the United States and around the world. Schreger is currently advising U.S. and international broadcasters, producers, and media companies. He consults with rights owners and their representatives in valuing profit participation and film librarians. He also has served as an expert witness in a variety of rights disputes. In addition, he is an adjunct professor of marketing at the NYU Stern School of Business. Previously, Schreger was the president of HBO Enterprises (July 1990-December 2019). He also served as the executive vice president and assistant to the CEO from 2018-2020. Prior to HBO, Schreger was president of a division of Columbia Pictures and a senior executive with independent production companies, where he gained intimate knowledge of studio and independent film and television production. He also worked closely with HBO and Time Warner senior management on numerous strategic initiatives. Prior to HBO, Schreger served as senior vice president and assistant to the CEO of the Samuel Goldwyn Company; and at Columbia Pictures as senior vice president, film acquisitions, and as president, Triumph Films, a joint venture between Columbia and Gaumont. Before entering the entertainment industry, Schreger was a journalist and staff writer with Variety and the Los Angeles Times. He speaks frequently at industry conferences and is a media analyst for Bloomberg News and NPR Marketplace.

records.Name: Dale Y. Kim, CPA
records.Bio__c: Dale Y. Kim, CPA, is a partner at PwC. Prior to this, he was a partner in the state and local tax practice of Ernst & Young LLP. Based in the New York City office, Kim led the firm's real estate, hospitality, and construction market segment SALT practice. Prior to joining Ernst & Young in 2017, he worked in the state and local tax practice of KPMG LLP, focusing on banking and capital markets; wealth and asset management; and real estate, hospitality, and construction sector clients. He has been a speaker for numerous organizations including the American Bar Association, the National Association of State Bar Tax Sections, the Tax Executives Institute, NAREIT, NCREIF, the Institute for Professionals in Taxation, the Council on State Taxation, NYSSCPA, MACPA, and the Committee of Banking Institutions on Taxation. Kim has served as an adjunct professor of tax in Fordham University's M.S. program in Taxation since 2012.

records.Name: Dana Trombley
records.Bio__c: Professor Dana Trombley is a digital marketing leader and educator. Currently managing creator (influencer) strategy at Amazon, she's worked extensively in digital publishing (Time Inc, NewsCorp, New York Magazine/Vox) and in the media advertising space (Dentsu Media) on social acquisition, digital communications, and commerce initiatives. She graduated from Fordham University's Gabelli School of Business with an M.S. in Media Management in 2014.

records.Name: Dario Fofic
records.Title__c: Adjunct Professor of Information, Technology and Operations
records.Bio__c: For more than 15 years, Dario Fofic has worked in the financial and healthcare sectors. Fofic carefully chose his career path by focusing on gaining experience across different business segments, which helped him to connect the dots across complex organizational structures. This experience enabled him to bridge the gap between business and technology departments. Since 2014, he has focused on developing talent across organizations through coaching, mentoring, and teaching future leaders. Fofic, who holds an M.B.A. from Fordham University's Gabellli School of Business, is an adjunct professor at his alma mater. He teaches courses on business analytics at the Gabelli School each year. Fofic takes great pride in being able to work with talented students on the cusp of burgeoning careers, knowing that they will be prepared to excel in their industry roles and that their future employers will benefit as a direct result.

records.Name: Denise L. Bennett
records.Bio__c: With 20+ years of media and entertainment marketing experience, Denise Bennett is a seasoned professional. She is currently the vice president of brand strategy at iHeartMedia, specializing in multicultural marketing partnerships. She is also an adjunct professor at Fordham University's Gabelli School of Business and New York University, where she teaches at the graduate level. Bennett has held marketing roles at WarnerMedia, Viacom, NBCUniversal, the NBA, and TV One. Her many accolades include The Network Journal's 40 Under 40 Achievement Award (2019), the Council of Urban Professionals (CUP) Catalyst Award (2020), the Black Women in Media's Trailblazer Award (2021), and the Advertising Club of NY Rockstar Award. She most recently was awarded the National Association of Multi-Ethnicity in Communications (NAMIC) Luminary Award (2022). Bennett holds a B.S. in music business from Indiana State University and an M.B.A. with a dual concentration in marketing and media and communications from Fordham University's Gabelli School of Business. She has served as the president and alumni liaison of the Fordham Black & Hispanic M.B.A. Association and vice president of the Fordham Media & Entertainment Alliance. She currently serves on the Fordham Gabelli Alumni DEI Council. Outside of her professional responsibilities, she is a classically trained pianist, an avid world traveler, and a proud & active member of Alpha Kappa Alpha Sorority, Inc.

records.Name: Desmond C.B. Lyons
records.Bio__c: Desmond C.B. Lyons is a full-time litigator and outside general counsel to nonprofits and other domestic and international entities. As a founding partner of a leading Westchester law firm, Lyons has been recognized by his peers for many years as a Super Lawyer for his work in the greater New York metropolitan area. In his more than 25 years of practice, he has litigated and tried cases at every level in local, state, and federal court; appellate courts; and administrative tribunals. Lyons is a member of the Westchester County Bar Association and the New York State Bar Association Federal and Commercial Litigation Section. He also serves on the President's Committee on Access to Justice and is chair of the New York State Constitution Simplification Committee. Lyons is the immediate past chair of the Westchester Committee of the Federal Bar Council and serves on its Second Circuit Courts Committee. He also has served on the Southern District's Federal Magistrate Merit Selection Panel. Since 2010, Lyons has served as the village justice for the Village of Irvington, New York . In this role, he presides over hundreds of criminal and civil matters each year. Lyons also serves as an accessible magistrate in Westchester County and has served as acting City Court judge for the City of White Plains, acting town judge for the Town of Greenburgh, and acting village justice in the Village of Mamaroneck. Lyons teaches in the Law and Ethics Area at Fordham University's Gabelli School of Business. As a first-generation American, Lyons is also involved in several organizations that seek to strengthen the cultural and business ties between the United States and the Republic of Ireland.

records.Name: Elizabeth Ostler
records.Bio__c: Elizabeth Ostler is the assistant dean of student engagement at Fordham University's Gabelli School of Business, where she oversees the Responsible Business Leadership Certificate Program. Ostler also is the founder and storyteller-in-chief of Life's Echoes. Offering workshops and opportunities for people to stand in their truth and tell their stories, she has helped individuals from a wide range of professions, such as executives, law students, academics, and artists, hone their messages and connect with their audience. Ostler is a theater-maker, specializing in directing and puppetry. In addition, she is editor-in-chief and contributing writer at The LDS Women's Project. Ostler holds an M.F.A. in Theater Directing from Brooklyn College, a B.A. in Liberal Arts from Sarah Lawrence College, and a Ph.D. in Contemporary Learning and Interdisciplinary Studies from Fordham University. Her research focuses on cultural master narratives and belonging.

records.Name: Evan Shapiro
records.Bio__c: Over the course of his career, Evan Shapiro has been an outspoken thought leader in the entertainment industry. For many years via his work with Ghetto Film School and One Day Immersion, he has strived to make the media business a more diverse and inclusive community. For decades, Shapiro has created innovative, award-winning programming and media properties, including "Take My Wife," "Funny Women of a Certain Age," "This Film Is Not Yet Rated" (Sundance Film Festival Collection), "Dinner for Five" (Emmy Nomination), "HitRecord" (Emmy Award), "Brick City" (Emmy Nomination and Peabody Award), and the iconic "Portlandia" (Peabody Award). He is currently producing the podcasts "Cancel Culture" and "Next with Novo"; the feature film "Grimm Legacy" for Disney+; the feature "All Over Christmas" with Vortex Pictures; and the series "Cooper's Bar" for AMC, which debuted on May 31, 2022.

records.Name: Frank Zambrelli
records.Bio__c: Frank Zambrelli is an expert in ESG/sustainability with C-suite experience in retail, luxury, and branding. His approach overlays the multiple lenses of P&L priority and the mitigation of negative environmental and social impacts, demonstrating the value sustainable systems change creates across organizations and supply chains. After more than a decade working for world-class brands, he launched the award-winning consultancy Design Quadrant, with a client roster including Chanel, Calvin Klein, Estee Lauder, Restoration Hardware, and Gucci. Today, Zambrelli serves as managing director and co-lead of Accenture's global ESG retail practice. An adjunct professor of marketing at Fordham University's Gabelli School of Business, Zambrelli is regularly quoted in the media and featured on panels discussing responsible business and the acceleration of ESG. He serves as the vice chair of Fashion Makes Change; the chairman of the Accessories Council; and an executive alumni board member at the Fashion Institute of Technology, where he earned a B.S. in Marketing Communications. Zambrelli also holds an M.S. in International Marketing with a concentration in sustainability from Glasgow Caledonian College New York.

records.Name: Helena Mayrant
records.Bio__c: Helena Mayrant is an experienced professional with a passion for communications, media strategy, and project management. Her success has been proven in social media, client relations, organizational structure, and systems integration projects. In her current role at Warner Bros. Discovery, she is crucial in building the bridges of communication and workflows amongst teams. Mayrant is a proud alumna of Fordham University's Gabelli School of Business, where she completed a bachelor's degree with a double concentration in marketing and communications and an M.S in Media Management.

records.Name: Howard Homonoff, J.D.
records.Bio__c: Howard Homonoff has been a leading executive, strategic advisor and thought leader in the media business for over 20 years. He has worked with traditional and digital media companies, brands, agencies, and tech firms with a focus on driving revenue growth and strategic partnerships for clients such as The Walt Disney Company, Comcast, NBCUniversal, Fox Television, the Motion Picture Association, the 4As, the Association of National Advertisers and SAG-AFTRA. Homonoff also has served as an expert witness on the media industry in proceedings before federal courts, the Federal Communications Commission, and the Copyright Royalty Board. In addition to serving as an adjunct professor in Fordham University's Gabelli School of Business graduate media management program, Homonoff is the senior advisor for the media & entertainment industry at Grant Thornton Advisors; a weekly contributor to Forbes on media, advertising, and entertainment; and senior fellow at Columbia Business School's Institute on Tele-Information (CITI). Prior to his work in strategy consulting, Homonoff served as general counsel for NBC Cable Networks and vice president and general manager of CNBC Strategic Ventures where, in addition to his business development duties, he managed the P&L of NBCU's early-stage business units including streaming media, satellite radio, broadcast syndication, interactive TV, and the launch of CNBC World. He also served as counsel to the U.S. House of Representatives Subcommittee on Telecommunications and Finance. Homonoff is a graduate of New York University School of Law and Cornell University.

records.Name: Ikechi Okoronkwo
records.Bio__c: Ikechi Okoronkwo is global executive director for advanced analytics at Mindshare. In this role, he helps clients to develop actionable mechanisms to leverage data in new ways and embrace innovations in applied AI and predictive analytics. Okoronkwo's contributions to the industry were recognized in 2020 when he was selected by Adweek as a Media All-Star for leading the creation of Mindshare's analytics and scenario-planning platform, Synapse. In 2023, Okoronkwo was hailed by Business Insider as one of 15 advertising executives leading the industry's charge into generative AI. A member of the Forbes Technology Council, he also serves on the board of directors for the Media Rating Council. Okoronkwo teaches courses in marketing analytics insights at Fordham University's Gabelli School of Business. He also has taught at Pace University's Lubin School of Business, where he earned an M.B.A. Okoronkwo, who also holds a bachelor's degree in international business from Manhattanville College, organizes case competitions to provide experiential learning opportunities for the next generation of analytics and marketing professionals.

records.Name: Jed Dorfman
records.Bio__c: joined Fordham University's Gabelli School of Business with over 20 years of professional experience. At the Gabelli School, he has taught both Career Exploration and Business Communication. Beyond his leadership in camping, Dorfman is a sought-after speaker and trainer at industry conferences. He was a founding director of America's Camp, a nonprofit that ran for 10 years, serving children who lost a parent on September 11. He also is the founder and executive director of Zeal Adventure and Travel, a summer travel and community service program for high school students. When not working or teaching, he can usually be found on the sidelines, coaching or cheering on his three children in their sports endeavors.

records.Name: Jenna Cook, Ph.D.
records.Bio__c: With over six years of experience in higher education, Jenna Cook, Ph.D., brings with her experiences from a multitude of educational sectors, including but not limited to academic advising, holistic learning support, enrollment management, student organization oversight, and teaching. In her current role as the assistant dean for seniors at Fordham University's Gabelli School of Business, Cook oversees the academic progress and graduation clearance of over 600 students, collaborates with faculty and staff members to ensure the alignment of the curriculum with the mission and objectives of the School, and implements strategies to improve retention and completion rates. In addition to her administrative role, she is an adjunct professor in the Communications and Media Management Area at the Gabelli School, teaching the Career Exploration course. She also has served as an adjunct professor of English at Berkeley College and Saint Peter's University, where she taught various writing, literature, and research courses. Cook holds a Ph.D. in Literacy from St. John's University, an M.A. in English and Creative Writing from Southern New Hampshire University, and a B.A. in English Language and Literature from New Jersey City University. Additionally, she has multiple tutoring, teaching, and supplemental instruction certifications. Cook has a strong background in online and in-person pedagogy, curriculum development, assessment, and academic support. She is a passionate and dedicated academic leader who is deeply committed to the tenet of cura personalis, "care for the whole person," and strives to incorporate this philosophy in her everyday work.

records.Name: Joe Dieguez
records.Bio__c: Joe Dieguez is currently the director of career development for the Gabelli School of Business, overseeing all graduate programs. Prior to this role, he worked at Google as a recruiter who concentrated primarily in the Early Careers campus recruiting space. His focus was primarily on Ph.D. and M.B.A. recruiting for both tech and non-tech roles within multiple product areas at Google. Dieguez started his career at PwC, where he spent the first half of his time working as a tax professional focusing on provision, compliance, and consulting work across multiple industries. He then pivoted into a career with Talent Acquisition at PwC during the second half of his tenure, primarily recruiting from colleges and universities in the New York metropolitan area and hiring undergraduate and graduate students into PwC's Audit, Tax, and Consulting practices. Dieguez graduated with a Bachelor of Science in Public Accounting and a Master of Science in Professional Taxation from Fordham University's Gabelli School of Business.

records.Name: Joe Lizza, CPA
records.Bio__c: Joe Lizza earned a bachelor's degree in accountancy from St. Peter's University, in 1978 and became a CPA in May 1981. Prior to establishing Lizza & Carullo CPAs & Advisors in 1991, Lizza spent over 10 years in both private industry and public accounting, developing a keen sense of management decision-making for profitability, sustainability, and growth. This expertise was further enhanced when he earned an M.B.A. in Innovation and Entrepreneurship from Felician University in 2008. During his 29 years at the helm of the firm, he has applied his knowledge to assist many clients with what he calls" Infusion Management." Additionally, for over 25 years, Lizza has shared his expertise in the classroom. He is an adjunct professor of accounting at Fordham University's Gabelli School of Business and also has taught business courses at Rutgers University, Felician University, and the Becker CPA Review Company. His expertise in finance, accounting, and education has been recognized by his clients and peers. Lizza has received numerous honors including the Rutgers Accounting Society's Teacher of the Year award (1996, 1997); Becker CPA Review Company's Excellence in Teaching award (2003, 2005); New Jersey Monthly's Five Star Top Wealth Manager's Award in Business Planning (2011, 2012, 2013); The Italian Voice's Best of New Jersey Award of Excellence (2014); Felician University's Distinguished Alumni Award (2015); the Dean's Award for Teaching Excellence from Fordham University; the Dean's Award for Teaching Excellence from Felician University (2017); NJCPA's Volunteer Award (2018); NJCPA's Ovation Award: Education Excellence (2019); and the NJBIZ ICON Award (2020).

records.Name: John Vitale, CPA
records.Bio__c: John Vitale is a partner in the East region tax practice of Ernst & Young LLP (EY). Vitale has advised clients across industries including retail, pharmaceutical, entertainment, sports, construction, and technology in accounting for income taxes under ASC 740, planning and structuring business transactions, and taxation of partnerships and partners. He advises assurance and non-assurance clients and EY engagement teams on ASC 740 considerations arising in business combinations, restructurings, divestiture transactions, international tax planning, and investments in partnerships. Vitale is a frequent speaker on accounting for income taxes and is an instructor in several of the firm's training and educational programs related to accounting for income taxes, partnership taxation, and corporate taxation. In addition to his client-serving role, he also has served as the Northeast Sub-Area Channel One Tax Accounting and Risk Advisory Services leader and was a member of the National Tax Practice TARAS Group and the Partnership Tax Group. Vitale has over 29 years of experience with EY and is a graduate of Brooklyn College (B.S. in Accounting), Fordham University (M.S. in Taxation), and William Howard Taft University (J.D.). He is an adjunct professor at Fordham University's Gabelli School of Business and has served as an instructor in the graduate tax program at William Howard Taft University. Vitale is a CPA licensed in New York State and is licensed as an attorney in California. He is a member of the California Bar Association, the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants, the American Bar Association, and the New York State Society of Certified Public Accountants.

records.Name: Jonathan Palgon
records.Bio__c: Jonathan Palgon currently serves as senior director of product at Bleacher Report. His previous roles include ad ops manager at Conde Nast, media operations and analysis manager at TouchTunes, and senior director of ad ops and account management at Insticator. Palgon graduated from Duke University with an bachelor's degree in economics and a minor in history. He earned an M.B.A. from Fordham in 2017, with a dual concentration in communications and media management, and finance.

records.Name: Jonathan Zile
records.Bio__c: Jonathan Zile is currently the senior vice president of data solutions at Internet Brands and PulsePoint,, and is an adjunct professor of marketing at Fordham University's Gabelli School of Business. Zile has worked for 18 years to build innovative products, lead groundbreaking research efforts, and create transformational solutions. He is passionate about data and applying problem-solving techniques to all aspects of his profession. He studied marketing at the Gabelli School and electrical engineering at Duke University.

records.Name: Joseph N. Juliano
records.Bio__c: Joseph Juliano is a Gabelli School alumnus and an adjunct professor of marketing, entering his 10th year teaching at Fordham University. Juliano brings over 30 years of real-world experience in marketing and sales to the classroom. He began his career in key account sales at Anheuser-Busch and then transitioned into brand management at Pepperidge Farm. Juliano then accepted a role at Nestle, where he helped to drive significant growth across both the domestic and international beverage portfolio. Juliano led brands such as Poland Spring, Perrier, San Pellegrino, and Aqua Panna. He spearheaded the Innovation group, created the division's first powdered vitamin supplement, and helped to launch Nestle's first health and hydration retail stores. He then transitioned into the OTC/supplement industry as the vice president of marketing and general manager at Prestige Consumer Healthcare, where he managed leading brands such as Clear Eyes, Dramamine, Gaviscon, Dentek, Beano, BC/Goody's, Chloraseptic, and Luden's. Juliano is currently vice president of marketing and sales at Applied Biological Laboratories. He earned both his undergraduate and M.B.A. degrees at Fordham University and lives in Westport, Connecticut.

records.Name: Joseph Zirpolo
records.Bio__c: Joseph Zirpolo is the global head of training at Houlihan Lokey and a member of the firm's Human Capital Management Department. He has over 25 years of training experience at investment banks, private equity firms, multinational corporations, and consulting firms, as well as many top universities around the world. Zirpolo currently leads Houlihan Lokey's firm-wide intern and full-time training programs, as well as continuing development courses throughout the year. He is based in the firm's New York office. Zirpolo holds a B.A. in economics and business administration from Ursinus College and an M.B.A. from Fordham University. Currently he is an adjunct professor of finance at Fordham, where he has won the Dean's Award for Teaching Excellence five times.

records.Name: Kate Shea Kennon, Ed.D.
records.Bio__c: Kate Shea Kennon, Ed.D., is an assistant dean of academic advising at Fordham University's Gabelli School of Business, where she supports students in the M.S. in Media Management program. Kennon also directs student engagement in the Responsible Business Center, exploring research and career opportunities in sustainability. She is a board member of the Jesuit Business Network, which brings together Jesuit colleges and universities from all over the U.S. to share best practices in student services. She also is a Jesuit School Student Success Network member and is on the steering committee for the Student-Athlete Advising community, NACADA. Kennon holds a doctorate in Educational Leadership and Administration from Fordham University, an M.A. in English from Western Connecticut University, and a B.A. in English from St. Bonaventure University, where she co-leads an alum cycling club. Her research continues to focus on intercultural communications, student-athlete advising, and sustainability initiatives. She also serves on the board of Origin Theater and is honored to be on the jury for the annual Irish Theater Festival. New York is her campus - especially NYC theater - so look for her way up in the mezzanine in an aisle seat.

records.Name: Kathleen Olsen, CPA
records.Bio__c: Since 2014, Kathleen Olsen serves as chair of the Audit Committee and director of Green Brick Partners, Inc (NYSE: GRBK). GRBK is a diversified homebuilding and land development company that currently operates in Texas, Georgia, Colorado, and Florida. From 1999 through 2011, Olsen served as chief financial officer of Eminence Capital, LLC, a long/short global equity fund. From 1993 to 1999, she served as audit manager, specializing in investment partnerships, at Anchin, Block & Anchin LLP, a public accounting firm located in New York City. Olsen received a Bachelor of Science degree with honors from the State University of New York at Albany. She is a Certified Public Accountant and a member of the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants, the New York State Society of Certified Public Accountants, and the National Association of Corporate Directors. In addition, Olsen is currently an adjunct professor at Fordham University's Gabelli School of Business. Her philanthropic endeavors include being a docent and trustee at Lockwood-Mathews Mansion Museum in Norwalk, Connecticut, and the chair of the Finance Committee and a trustee at Saint Catherine Center for Special Needs in Fairfiled, Connecticut.

records.Name: Kenneth Muckenhaupt
records.Title__c: Adjunct Professor of Information, Technology and Operations
records.Bio__c: Professor Kenneth Muckenhaupt is a retired IBM executive consultant for financial services sector clients. Muckenhaupt has over 38 years of experience in IBM hardware and software development. During his IBM career, he developed microcode for IBM mainframe processors, managed a mainframe microcode development department, and worked in various software engineering assignments. In his financial services sector consulting role, he provided thought leadership for the integration of IBM hardware and middleware technologies for the development of complex, multiplatform banking and financial market solutions. Muckenhaupt remains active during his retirement as an adjunct professor at Fordham University's Gabelli School of Business, where he teaches courses in information systems and modern operations, and supply chain management. Outside of Fordham, Muckenhaupt serves as a part-time emergency medical technician at Mobile Life Support Services, and a lab instructor for the Emergency Medical Services education program at Dutchess Community College. He and his wife, Judith, reside in Poughkeepsie, New York.

records.Name: Kerry O'Grady, Ed.D.
records.Bio__c: Kerry O'Grady, Ed.D., is a faculty affairs expert, sought-after pedagogical innovation consultant, award-winning curriculum developer and professor, and seasoned communications practitioner. Her present teaching appointments include courses in marketing, communications, and management at Fordham University, The University of Massachusetts Amherst, and Holy Family University. Recent past positions include director of teaching excellence at Columbia Business School and faculty director and associate professor of practice for the Master's in Public Relations and Corporate Communications program at Georgetown's School of Continuing Studies. Prior to Georgetown, she spent eight years at the NYU School of Professional Studies, leading and teaching in its M.S. in Public Relations and Corporate Communication program. A fearless author on systemic issues in higher education, she's authored pieces for Inside Higher Ed and The Chronicle of Higher Education. With professional experience in public relations, integrated marketing, and advertising, past corporate positions include associate director, integrated marketing for Women's Health magazine; senior manager, integrated marketing at Parents, FamilyFun, and American Baby magazines (Meredith Corp.); business development manager, La Voz and TV y Mas; and advertising executive, The Arizona Republic (Gannett, Inc.). She's also held consulting roles at Saatchi & Saatchi, Viacom, and TalkSpace. She is a regular pundit and media source, as seen in The Washington Post, The New York Post, The Telegraph, and on ABC News' digital podcast "Uncomfortable." She's been honored with many awards, including President's Club (Gannett, Inc.), Marketing Campaign of the Year Finalist (Meredith Corp.), the Public Relations Society of America - NY top "35 Under 35" winner, and NYU's "Outstanding Service" award. She holds a B.A. (summa cum laude) in both Journalism and English from The University of Massachusetts Amherst; an M.S in Public Relations & Corporate Communication (with distinction) from New York University, and an Ed.D. in Leadership and Learning in Organizations from Vanderbilt University.

records.Name: Linda Gironda
records.Bio__c: Linda Gironda works as an attorney for the Office of General Counsel at Fox Rothschild. She earned a B.A. in philosophy at Iona College, an M.B.A. in marketing with a certificate in international business from Fordham University's Gabelli School of Business, and a law degree from Pace University. In addition, Gironda holds a doctorate in education from Columbia University, where she researched how universities use online technology to connect students from different countries to develop intercultural competencies and promote global diversity. At the Gabelli School, Gironda teaches Legal Framework of Business and the Ground Floor course for first-year students. She also has taught undergraduate legal studies courses at Purchase College (SUNY) and graduate level leadership courses at Manhattan College. In 2018, Gironda was awarded the Chancellor's Award for Excellence in Adjunct Teaching at Purchase College.

records.Name: Linda J. Luca
records.Bio__c: Linda J. Luca teaches integrated marketing communications at Fordham University's Gabelli School of Business and is a co-director of the School's M.S. in Marketing intelligence. Prior to joining Fordham, Luca was an EVP, group managing director, for McCann New York and served as the agency's New York leader for training young talent. For over 30 years, she managed integrated campaigns for Unilever, Cadbury-Adams, J&J Acuvue, Major League Baseball, Lowe's Home Improvement, Coca-Cola's Powerade, and others. Her success was recognized with Effies and AME awards for advertising effectiveness. Later, Luca served as a judge for these same prestigious competitions. She also has received accolades for her work in the classroom, including the Gabelli Faculty Cura Personalis Award, the Teaching Excellence Award (Part Time), and the Dean's Award for Impact. Luca holds an M.B.A. in finance from Pace University's Lubin School of Business and a B.A. in History from the University of Michigan.

records.Name: Liuling Liu
records.Bio__c: Liuling Liu holds a Ph.D. in finance from Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute (RPI) and an M.S. in actuarial science from the University of Kent in the U.K. She has experience in teaching financial technology (fintech), cryptocurrency and blockchain (NFT), financial markets, financial institutions and risk management. Her research has been published in several core academic journals such as the Journal of Financial Intermediation, the Journal of Corporate Finance, the Journal of Banking & Finance, the Journal of Business Ethics, the Journal of Financial Stability, the Journal of International Money and Finance, and the Journal of Financial Service Research, among others.

records.Name: Logan West
records.Bio__c: Logan West is the marketing manager for digital and display advertising on the Amazon Digital Advertising team. He manages the partnership with the NFL and oversees first-party advertising for Thursday Night Football and other live sports. West joined Amazon after managing digital marketing for The New York Times and Sotheby's Auction House on their education products. He has been featured in Apartment Therapy and worked with influencers like Elena Taber to show off his unique apartment in the city. Most recently he was featured on oHouse, an interior design platform that integrates content, community, and commerce. West holds bachelor's degrees in graphic design and German studies from the University of Minnesota Duluth and a master's degree in media management from Fordham University's Gabelli School of Business.

records.Name: Lori Greene
records.Bio__c: Lori Greene is an educator, digital marketer, strategist, content creator, and a frequent speaker on digital subjects. Currently she runs external workforce training as the global education manager at Netflix, is an adjunct instructor both at New York University's School of Professional Studies and Fordham University's Gabelli School of Business, and is on the board at Temple University's Fox Business School. She was a television producer at Food Network, Lifetime, and The Travel Channel; ran digital at BBC America, The History Channel, and Court TV; devised content at Time Inc.; and won numerous awards for her work. As founder of LPG Enterprises, Greene helped brands such as Intel, NBC Universal, Indeed, Oppenheimer Funds, the Village Voice, Citi, Merck, the Association of National Advertisers, and more, with education, digital marketing, ideation, editorial, content marketing, social media, facilitation, and more.

records.Name: Michael Ning
records.Bio__c: Michael Ning is a managing director at MacKay Shields. Ning has over 20 years of experience in the financial industry, and he has held senior positions at some of the world's leading investment firms. Ning is an expert in global macro investing and has a deep understanding of trading, portfolio optimization, tail-hedging, and global-macro fundamentals. He also is an adjunct professor at Fordham University, where he teaches quantitative finance and machine learning. He holds a Ph.D. from Oxford University and is a Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA).

records.Name: Nariman Gathers
records.Bio__c: Nariman Gathers does process. They turn the mushiness of humaning (being a person) into discrete, discernible task flow. Gathers has used this superpower to help design communications identity at Code2040, build and sustain distributed teams at GitHub, manage incident communications at Slack, tackle some of the nation's most pressing issues with the ACLU, and helm the design ops program at Plaid. They currently manage Design Operations at Verily, an Alphabet Company, and teach design process at Stanford's d.school, Fordham University, and the New School at Parsons. Gathers is the recipient of the 2022 Converse University Young Alumni Prize and a TedX Stanford speaker. They are a proud plant dad, a champion for neurodiversity, and will cry about friend-shaped objects.

records.Name: Navid Youssefian
records.Bio__c: Born in Paris and based in New York, Navid Youssefian is a senior manager on the Revenue Enablement team at MetLife, where he leads data engineering initiatives that power strategic sales and marketing activation for the investment management business. With a career spanning the banking, nonprofit, and tech sectors, he brings a unique blend of analytical precision and creative strategy to his work. Prior to his current role, Youssefian held positions in strategic and digital marketing, where he built impactful campaigns that bridged brand storytelling with measurable outcomes. Beyond the corporate world, he is a co-founder of evlovesnyc, a NYC grassroots nonprofit born in the early days of the pandemic that has since cooked and distributed over 600,000 meals to people in need across all five boroughs. Outside of work, Youssefian finds inspiration in nature and motion - whether it's hiking, skiing, or capturing landscapes through drone videography. A passionate soccer enthusiast, he has been a devoted Paris Saint-Germain fan since the age of eight. Youssefian is always looking to link with creative minds - feel free to connect with him on LinkedIn!

records.Name: Quincy Olatunde
records.Bio__c: Quincy Olatunde is a dynamic product management executive with a passion for people and human-centric solutions, backed by the power of data AI. He is an industry-agnostic visionary, whose unwavering focus on people-centric products and data fuels groundbreaking solutions. With a profound understanding of human needs and desires, he has mastered the art of crafting products that resonate deeply with businesses and consumers. "It's not just about features and functionalities," he notes "it's about the emotional connection between users, businesses and their products, and a focus on making sure that the right output and outcome stay mutually aligned." At the core of Olatunde's approach lies a genuine passion for people - both consumers and teams alike, with an unwavering belief that success thrives on empathy, collaboration, and trust. By fostering an inclusive and innovative environment, he empowers teams to deliver their best work, resulting in products that surpass expectations. But it doesn't stop there. Olatunde is not content with just intuition and emotions. He knows that data is the heartbeat of every successful product. With an exceptional ability to harness the power of data-driven insights, he helps drive informed decisions, measure outcomes, and optimize products for growth and scalability. This unique blend of people-centricity and data-driven acumen positions him at the forefront of industries, both core and emerging.

records.Name: Remy Blaire
records.Bio__c: Remy Blaire is a seasoned business journalist and communications professional with international experience in finance and management. She earned her executive M.B.A. from Fordham University's Gabelli School of Business, where she was a recipient of the Dean's Scholarship and the Academic Area Award in Strategy & Statistics. Blaire is a distinguished member of Alpha Sigma Nu and the National Honor Society of the Financial Management Association. She graduated magna cum laude from NYU with a B.A. in International Studies. Dedicated to excellence in both academia and journalism, Blaire is committed to inspiring students and audiences alike through innovative teaching methodologies and insightful analysis.

records.Name: Rich Bengloff
records.Bio__c: Rich Bengloff teaches the Music Business course at Fordham University's Gabelli School of Business and is the former president of the American Association of Independent Music, a not-for-profit trade organization that represents over 500 independent music labels across the United States. Bengloff has spent more than 30 years in the music and entertainment industry, having worked at Telemundo and Columbia Pictures; music labels and music distributors at both independent (RED, Combat/Relativity/In Effect) and major music companies (Sony Music and Warner Music); as well as WNYC Radio, where he served as a senior level operations and financial executive.

records.Name: Robert F. Bohn
records.Bio__c: For the past 30 years, Robert F. Bohn has worked as a marketing director at prominent organizations, including The Leukemia & Lymphoma Society, Metro New York, People Magazine, Forbes, PRIMEDIA, ESPN, and Kiplinger's Personal Finance. He also has maintained a successful creative consulting business, CCI, since 2010. In addition, Bohn has taught extensively at the undergraduate and graduate levels, sharing his real-world experience with students through online, hybrid, and in-person classes. He currently teaches marketing, brand management, and business administration at Fordham University's Gabelli School of Business. Bohn previously taught at New York University's School of Professional Studies, where he received the General Excellence Award for Teaching. Bohn, who holds a B.S. in Marketing and Communications from Manhattan College and an M.B.A. in Marketing and Management Science from St. John's University, is currently pursuing a Ph.D. in Business Management with a marketing focus from Capella University

records.Name: Robert P. Gach
records.Bio__c: Robert P. Gach is currently an adjunct professor and chair of the Gabelli School of Business Advisory Board.. He also serves on the President's Council of Fordham University and as the senior alumni-in -residence for the Graduate Career Center. Previously, Gach spent 37 years at the global consulting and technology firm, Accenture, where his client work included service to capital markets clients (investment banks, wealth managers, exchanges, and custodians). He led engagements on strategy development, cost and efficiency improvement, market development, digital transformation, technology planning, operations strategy, and enterprise change. During his time at Accenture, Gach served the global marketplace and spent seven years in Asia Pacific. He held a number of leadership positions at the firm - all in the financial services industry with a deep specialization in capital markets. Gach served as a member of Accenture's Global Leadership Council, which was comprised of the top 150 leaders of the firm. He also was the co-founder of the FinTech Innovation Lab - an incubator for financial services start-ups, which had offices in New York, Dublin, London, and Hong Kong. Gach earned a B.S. Accounting at the Gabelli School in 1980.

records.Name: Russell Fink
records.Bio__c: Russell Fink is an adjunct professor at Fordham University's Gabelli School of Business, where he educates the next generation of media executives on the ins and outs of the ever-evolving media landscape by teaching classes such as Television: An Evolving Landscape and Media Executive Playbook. His most recent book, The Media Spectacle: Captivating the Audience, was published in 2024 and is available on Amazon and at Barnes & Noble. Fink holds a B.F.A. in film and television from New York University's Tisch School of the Arts and an M.B.A. in marketing and mass communication from the Gabelli School. He started his career as a freelance television producer for networks such as VH1, MTV, and Comedy Central before moving into multiplatform programming, development, and analytics at companies such as Court TV, A&E, and Showtime Networks. Fink then combined his passion for sports and programming by moving to the regional sports network, SNY, where he is currently the senior director of programming and content analytics. His role at SNY enables him to keep a bird's eye view of the current RSN business model and the changing world of cable. After spending the past 25 years in the world of media and almost 20 years specifically in sports media, Russell has a proven track record of continually developing an optimal digital/linear programming mix that drives sustained viewership growth. His extensive experience with every facet of multiplatform programming makes him an in-demand guest speaker for media conferences, podcasts, and panels. In April 2022, he was selected by TV Leaders Today to be profiled for his work as a sports executive.

records.Name: Samuel Blank
records.Bio__c: In addition to over 30 years of experience as a classroom instructor, Blank has worked as an adjunct professor of communications at CUNY, where he created and taught upper-level skills courses in conflict resolution. He also designed and taught crisis management courses at the Graduate School of Educational Leadership at Pace University and the School of Industrial and Labor Relations at Cornell University. Blank authored an enterprise/college textbook, Managing Organizational Conflict, which was published by McFarland and Company in 2020. He is on the faculty at the American Management Association, where he taught workshops in negotiation, and is an adjunct professor at Fordham University's Gabelli School of Business.

records.Name: Tim Ryan, CPA, CISA
records.Title__c: Adjunct Professor of Information, Technology and Operations
records.Bio__c: Tim Ryan has been with Sheltered Harbor since January 2017 and currently serves as managing director of adherence. Ryan also serves as an adjunct professor at Fordham University's Gabelli School of Business, teaching IT Audit/Information Assurance and Cybersecurity. Starting in May 2014, he was with GE Capital Internal Audit and served as a director of internal audit quality assurance for technology. Prior to his tenure at GE Capital, Ryan worked at Citigroup and served as a program director, covering technology audit within the Finance, Capital Markets, Corporate Functions, Compliance and AML divisions. During his 20-plus years with Citigroup, he managed numerous technology audits of information security and applications controls, and served as a subject matter expert for business continuity. Ryan also developed audit guidance and training programs for application controls, end-user computing and business continuity. Previously, he held a variety of audit roles at Prudential and at Automatic Data Processing, where he began his career as an operations and technical support manager. Ryan is a leadership member of the NY IIA, an IIA GTAG guidance contributor, an officer in the RMA Internal Audit Council, and an InfraGard member (NY Chapter). He earned graduate degrees from Fairleigh Dickenson University and Stevens Institute, along with a B.S. in accounting from the University of Scranton and holds CPA and CISA certifications. Ryan and his family reside in Northern New Jersey.

records.Name: Timothy P. Hedley, Ph.D., CPA, CFF, CFE
records.Bio__c: Timothy P. Hedley is an executive-in-residence at Fordham University's Gabelli School of Business. Hedley is responsible for the School's ESG literacy programs, and he teaches courses in sustainability reporting, business risks in a digital global economy, forensic accounting, managerial accounting, accounting fundamentals, and business ethics. Hedley is a retired partner at a Big Four accounting firm, where he served as the global lead partner for fraud risk management services. As a consultant, Hedley helps clients across a broad range of industries to prevent, detect, and respond to governance and integrity issues. He is also the co-author of The New Era of Regulatory Enforcement: A Comprehensive Guide for Raising the Bar to Manage Risk and Managing the Risk of Fraud and Misconduct: Meeting the Challenges of a Global, Regulated and Digital Environment. Hedley is chair of the Connecticut Society of CPAs and founding chair of its ESG Committee. In addition, he serves on the board of the Center for Professional Accounting Practices. A Certified Public Accountant and a Certified Fraud Examiner, Hedley also is Certified in Financial Forensics. He holds a B.B.A in accounting from Sienna College and an M.S. in accounting and a Ph.D. in public management (accounting and control) from the University at Albany, SUNY.

records.Name: Wael Hibri
records.Title__c: Adjunct Professor of Information, Technology and Operations
records.Bio__c: Wael Hibri is the MTA's deputy chief transformation officer, leading the consolidation and transformation of administrative functions and the redesign of business processes. Before that he headed up Shared Services, serving 72,000 employees and 47,000 retirees. Services included non-core procurement, accounting, payroll, talent acquisition and benefits administration. In addition to this role, he oversaw information technology until December 2019. Wael became chief enterprise information officer of the MTA in 2004. Since then, he has led a series of initiatives, modernizing applications and infrastructure, and ultimately consolidating five separate IT departments. Wael earned an undergraduate degree in business administration from the American University in Beirut and an M.B.A. from the College of Saint Rose in Albany, New York. He also holds an M.A. in international political economy and development and a Ph.D. in economics from Fordham University. In addition to his responsibilities at the MTA, Wael is an adjunct faculty member at Fordham's Gabelli School of Business. He teaches courses in IT strategy and management, operations management, systems analysis and design, IT project management, data analysis, and economics.

records.Name: Walter Prahl
records.Bio__c: Walter Prahl is a retired partner at the New Jersey-based investment management firm Lord Abbett and an adjunct professor of finance at Fordham University's Gabelli School of Business, where he teaches courses in ESG investing. Over the course of a multi-decade career at Lord Abbett, Prahl directed the firm's quantitative research effort and served as a portfolio manager for a host of equity and fixed income portfolios. An advocate of ESG investing throughout his career, he integrated ESG analysis and awareness into the portfolios he managed and led the development of ESG analytic capabilities across a broad array of asset classes. Previous career experience included positions at Goldman Sachs and Sanford C. Bernstein, Inc. Walter earned both his undergraduate degree and his Ph.D. in finance from the University of Wisconsin-Madison. He holds the CFA Institute's Certificate in ESG investing.

records.Name: Will Rockett, CFA
records.Bio__c: Will Rockett is an executive director of Eaton Vance Distributors, part of Morgan Stanley Investment Management (MSIM). Rockett leads RIA and family office distribution efforts across Eaton Vance's largest national RIA relationships. He is responsible for working closely with RIA home office professionals in product, asset allocation, and research positions. He joined Eaton Vance in 2019. Morgan Stanley acquired Eaton Vance in March 2021. Rockett began his career in the investment management industry in 1998. Before joining Eaton Vance, he was a managing director for Charles Schwab and led its fixed-income organization. Previously, he was a client portfolio manager and analyst at Symphony Asset Management, Cypress Management, and U.S. Trust Company. Rockett earned a B.A. from Rollins College and an M.B.A. from the NYU Stern School of Business. He is a CFA charterholder.

records.Name: Aditya Saharia
records.Research_Areas__c: Data Science; Information systems; Information economics; Service center management
records.Education__c: Ph.D.: Carnegie Mellon University; Master's: University of Rochester
records.Bio__c: Aditya Saharia, Ph.D., a professor of information systems at the Gabelli School of Business, teaches undergraduate and graduate courses in IT strategy, IT project management, e-commerce, and enterprise integration. He entered the field of information systems after beginning his career in theoretical physics. Professor Saharia's research focuses on applications of AI systems, information-systems strategy, database theory, information economics, ERP systems, and service-center management. His projects include AI applications, data visualization in healthcare data breaches, query optimization and query reuse in data-warehousing systems, IT and business alignment, challenges in IT integration in mergers and acquisitions, incentive-compatible contracts, and quality in outsourcing contracts. Before coming to Fordham, Professor Saharia served on the graduate faculty at the business schools of the University of Washington and University of Illinois, Chicago, supervising Ph.D. candidates at both institutions. Professor Saharia earned a Ph.D. in theoretical physics from Carnegie Mellon University. He did additional graduate work in operations research, economics, and computer information systems at the University of Rochester. Professor Saharia's work has appeared in leading journals in information systems and computer science. These include: IEEE Transactions on Knowledge and Data Engineering,ACM Transactions on Database Systems,Information Systems Research,Decision Support Systems and theJournal of Management Information Systems. Before he made the academic transition from physics to information systems, Professor Saharia's work in physcs was published in leading journals in theoretical physics, includingPhysical Review,Nuclear Physics,andPhysics Letters.Professor Saharia is the director of the Center for Digital Transformation and is the coordinator of Fordham CIO Roundtable. He has served as ITO area chair, director of the Fulltime M.B.A. program, and the director of the M.S. in IT program. Professor Saharia has served on the boards of several for-profit and nonprofit organizations.

records.Name: Ahir Gopaldas
records.Title__c: Associate Professor; Robert B. McKeon Endowed Chair in Business
records.Research_Areas__c: Brands and Branding; Consumer Culture Theory (CCT); Customer Experience Management (CXM); Transformative Service Research (TSR); Qualitative Research Methods
records.Education__c: Ph.D., Marketing, York University; M.B.A., Finance and Marketing, Drexel University; B.S.E., Systems Engineering, University of Pennsylvania
records.Bio__c: Ahir Gopaldas is an associate professor of marketing and currently holds the Robert B. McKeon Endowed Chair in Business at the Gabelli School of Business at Fordham University. His research focuses on current issues in marketing such as sustainability-oriented marketing, representation in the media, best practices in mental health services, and the social impact of new technologies. This research has been published in the Harvard Business Review, Journal of Consumer Research, Journal of Marketing, and other marketing research journals. Professor Gopaldas currently teaches Customer Experience Management and Marketing Principles. Prior to his academic career, he worked in finance, marketing, and technology roles at two multinational companies and two start-ups.His publications can be found atwww.ahirgopaldas.com. -

records.Name: Albert N. Greco
records.Research_Areas__c: Consumer Behavior; Book and Publishing Industry Marketing Trends; Cultural Industries Marketing Trends; Intellectual Property/Copyrights; Retail Industry Marketing Trends; Financial Industry Marketing Trends
records.Education__c: Ed.D.: New York University; Master's: M.A. Duquesne University; Bachelor's: B.A. Duquesne University
records.Bio__c: Albert N. Greco is an expert on the publishing world who researches and teaches at the Gabelli School of Business. His research centers on consumer marketing trends in publishing, as well as in the cultural, retail and financial-service fields. He has investigated the impact of econometric, demographic and technological developments on consumers and their decisions to buy, rent or use the goods and services produced by these industries. This book was translated into Chinese in 2010 by Renmin University Press (Beijing). - The Book Publishing Industry, 2nd edition (Mahwah, NJ: Lawrence Erlbaum & Associates, 2005). This book was translated into Chinese in 2009. Journal articles and chapters in books- "The Impact of the Inclusive Access Antitrust Lawsuit on U.S. College Bookstores, Book Publishers, and Educational Publishers," Publishing Research Quarterly 38, 3 (September 2022); pages 475-489; co-author with Alexandra Thomas, Emily Dunbar, Robert M. Wharton.

records.Name: Alex B. Markle
records.Research_Areas__c: Judgment and Decision-Making; Strategic Decision-Making
records.Education__c: Ph.D.: Behavioral Science, The University of Chicago Booth School of Business, Chicago, IL; Bachelor's: Electrical and Computer Engineering, Carnegie Mellon University, Pittsburgh, PA
records.Bio__c: Management Science, Strategic Management Journal, and theJournal of Risk and Uncertainty.Dr. Markle has also taught decision-making as an assistant professor at the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology and as a visiting professor at the Wharton School of the University of Pennsylvania. Dr. Markle holds a Ph.D. in behavioral science from The University of Chicago Booth School of Business, and a B.S. in engineering from Carnegie Mellon University. Dr. Markle has taught courses in strategy, judgment and decision-making, and negotiation at the graduate and undergraduate levels.

records.Name: Allie Kosterich
records.Research_Areas__c: Media Transformation; Media Management; Professionalization; Institutional Change; Organizational Change; Media Innovation
records.Education__c: Ph.D.: Rutgers University, 2017; Bachelor's: Cornell University, 2009
records.Bio__c: Allie Kosterich is an associate professor of communications and media management at the Gabelli School of Business. She holds a Ph.D. in communication from Rutgers University. Dr. Kosterich's research and teaching focus on media management and industry change. In particular, she is interested in understanding the transformation of media industries as a result of technological and social change. She does so by drawing on theory from both management and communication, as well as both quantitative methods such as social network analysis and event history analysis and qualitative methods such as interviews and textual analysis. Her work is supported by funding from the Tow Center for Digital Journalism at Columbia University where she is a Knight News Innovation Fellow. Merging theory with practice, Dr. Kosterich has established an active research agenda that studies the interaction of media organizations, institutions, and new technologies. Her work has been widely published in leading academic journals, as well as in the popular press. Dr. Kosterich's research and teaching interests stem in part from her professional media background, which includes management and production positions in newsrooms and television studios. Prior to that, she earned a B.S. in communication from Cornell University.

records.Name: An Yan
records.Title__c: The Robert Bendheim Chair Professor in Economics; and Financial Policy; Professor of Finance and Area Chair; Co-Director of the Center for Research in Contemporary Finance; 45 Columbus
records.Research_Areas__c: Corporate Restructuring; Initial Public Offerings; Corporate Social Responsibility; Behavior Finance; Capital Structure
records.Education__c: Ph.D.: Boston College; Master's: Boston College; Bachelor's: Tsinghua University, China
records.Bio__c: An Yan is the Robert Bendheim Chair Professor in Economics and Financial Policy and area chair at the Gabelli School of Business. Professor Yan is also the director of the Doctor of Professional Studies in Business program in collaboration with Peking University's National School of Development, and co-director of the Center for Research in Contemporary Finance. Professor Yan received his undergraduate degree from Tsinghua University, China, and his Ph.D. in finance from Boston College. His main research interest is in theoretical and empirical corporate finance. He has published his research in the Journal of Financial Economics, the Review of Financial Studies, the Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis and other significant academic outlets.

records.Name: Andrey Ermolov
records.Title__c: Associate Professor; Felix E. Larkin Distinguished Professorship in Management
records.Research_Areas__c: Financial economics; Macroeconomics; Econometrics
records.Education__c: Ph.D.: Finance and economics, Columbia Business School; Master's: MPhil, finance and economics, Columbia Business School; Bachelor's: Finance, Helsinki School of Economics; BSc and MSc, engineering physics and mathematics, Helsinki University of Technology
records.Bio__c: Andrey Ermolov is a financial economist working in the areas of asset pricing, macro finance, and financial econometrics. He joined the Gabelli School of Business as an assistant professor of finance and business economics in 2015, after receiving his Ph.D. from Columbia Business School. In 2023, promoted to associate professor. His research has won multiple prestigious awards, including the WFA Cubist Systematic Strategies Ph.D. Candidate Award for Outstanding Research; has been presented at leading economics and finance conferences, such as the NBER Summer Institute and Western Finance Association meeting; and has been published in the

records.Name: Aniko DeLaney
records.Bio__c: Aniko DeLaney is an advanced lecturer in the Marketing Area of the Fordham University Gabelli School of Business. She is a brand consultant at Oppenheimer & Co., Inc. where she is collaborating with the CMO on a strategic brand initiative. Prior to this role, DeLaney was head of Ultra High Net Worth Marketing for Bank of America's Private Bank and Merrill's Private Wealth Management. She completed the rebrand of US Trust to Bank of America Private Bank. Previously, DeLaney was chief marketing officer and global head of corporate marketing for BNY Mellon. She was responsible for BNY Mellon's enterprise-wide corporate brand strategy, digital marketing, and market research. She also led the rebranding of The Bank of New York Mellon to BNY Mellon. DeLaney attended Middlebury College and the NYU Stern School of Business. She was the vice chair of the Borough of Manhattan Community College Foundation Board for 10 years.

records.Name: Anthony DeFrancesco
records.Education__c: Master's: M.B.A., International Business, Dolan School of Business, Fairfield University, 2007; Michigan Ross School of Business, Pitney Bowes Executive Leaders Program (Strategy | Leadership | Finance | Customer Value); Babson College, Pitney Bowes Executive Leadership Program (Finance | Marketing | Strategy | Strategic Alliances | M/A | Customer Value | Management); Executive Program, Phillip Crosby Quality College, Total Quality Management; Bachelor's: Pace University
records.Bio__c: Mr. DeFrancesco served as vice president global business development and strategic planning at Pitney Bowes Inc. (PBI), Stamford, CT. As a member of the Pitney Bowes strategic leaders group and as vice president global mailstream solutions, product management, he created and drove strategy for business development, global channel partnerships, strategic technology alliances, and go-to-market product launch programs working with European, U.S., Canadian, Latin American, and Asia Pacific organizations. His global revenue focus was greater than $1.3 B, focusing on $10M to $50M deals. Mr. DeFrancesco led successful business unit/corporate strategic transformation programs working with major industry consultants on market research, analytics, cost reduction, supply chain, strategic alliances, channel optimization, acquisitions and divestitures, and strategy development and execution. Over his career Mr. DeFrancesco has also held various director and management-level roles in engineering, new product development, product planning, service operations, and quality assurance. At the request of the CEO, he served as corporate ambassador to the 9/11 Not-For-Profit Memorial Museum Foundation led by Michael Bloomberg which supported building the 9/11 Museum and led to Pitney Bowes being named for the "Partner of the Year Award" in 2012. At Fordham's Gabelli School of Business, Mr. DeFrancesco teaches courses in marketing, global marketing, integrated marketing communications, sales management, and B2B marketing. He served as mentor and faculty cohort for M.B.A. consulting projects and E.M.B.A. international field study programs. Mr. DeFrancesco also teaches courses in business strategy with experiential simulations, innovation and growth, new product development, global business, managerial marketing, and global marketing strategies.

records.Name: Apostolos Filippas
records.Title__c: Assistant Professor; Christopher Blake Distinguished Research Scholar in Business
records.Research_Areas__c: Online markets; Market design; Economics of technology
records.Education__c: Ph.D.: Business Administration, NYU Stern School of Business, 2018; Bachelor's: Computer Science, University of Patras, Greece, 2012
records.Bio__c: Apostolos Filippas is an economist working on market design and the economics of technology, primarily in the context of online platforms. He is currently an assistant professor at Fordham's Gabelli School of Business, and a research affiliate at the MIT Initiative on the Digital Economy (IDE). His recent research examines topics including the design of reputation and pricing systems in online marketplaces, the economic and public policy implications of the "sharing economy,'' and the design of social media platforms. His work has appeared in academic and popular press venues, including Management Science, the ACM conference on Economics and Computation, the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, the Washington Post, the LA Times, the Financial Times, and NPR. He earned his Ph.D. degree in Business Administration from NYU Stern School of Business, and his undergraduate degree in Computer Science (summa cum laude) from the University of Patras.

records.Name: Ayse Yemiscigil
records.Bio__c: Ayse Yemiscigil, Ph.D., is an Assistant Professor at Fordham University's Gabelli School of Business in the Leading People and Organizations area. She is a Research Affiliate with the Human Flourishing Program at Harvard University and the International Humanistic Management Association. Taking an interdisciplinary approach, Dr. Yemiscigil's research focuses broadly on the topic of leadership and human flourishing. She studies what leaders should know, do, and be to create system-wide flourishing and foster well-being in their selves, teams, organizations, and societies. Dr. Yemiscigil received her Ph.D. from Warwick Business School and has been a postdoctoral research fellow at The Human Flourishing Program at Harvard University and Harvard Kennedy School's Center for Public Leadership. -

records.Name: Barbara M. Porco
records.Title__c: Clinical Professor and Associate Dean of Graduate Studies; Managing Director of the Responsible Business Center; Executive Director for The Center for Professional Accounting Practices
records.Research_Areas__c: Sustainability Reporting; Ethics; Accounting Education; Risk Management; Auditing
records.Education__c: Ph.D.: Fordham University; Master's: M.A., Harvard University; Master's: M.B.A., Fordham University; Bachelor's: B.S. in Accounting, Fordham University
records.Bio__c: Barbara is a member of Fordham University's accounting faculty for over twenty-five years and currently serves as the associate dean of the graduate school of business and managing director of the Responsible Business Center (RBC). She has been the recipient of several academic awards including the American Accounting Association Ethics in Accounting Excellence Award, Faculty Magis Award, the Dean's Net Impact Award, and the Gabelli Teaching Innovation Award. Barbara has both a master's degree in sustainability and environmental management and a certification in corporate sustainability and innovation from Harvard University as well as the Wharton ESG Executive Certificate for Senior Leaders. She proudly serves on the AICPA's Sustainability Assurance and Advisory Task Force as the academic representative. Prior to her academic positions, she was a Tax Director and audit supervisor in the financial service group at PricewaterhouseCoopers. Leveraging her doctoral and post-doctoral studies, Barbara's research and teaching focuses on sustainability reporting and disclosures and accounting ethics. She is the author of KPMG Ethical Compass: Integrity in Business, a multi-series package of interactive instructional material that enables college professors to present ethics-related topics in their classrooms including topics with sustainability dimensions. The Ethical Compass has won multiple awards and has been used at more than 150 universities across the country and is available on KPMG's University Connection. Beyond being the multiple recipient of Fordham University's Teacher of the Year Award, Barbara has also been recognized nationally. Her academic and professional awards include the Excellence in Accounting Ethics Education Award, National Innovation in Auditing & Assurance Education Award, the National Teaching Innovation Award from the American Accounting Association, NACE Excellence in Teaching Award for KPMG's Ethical Compass, and National Outstanding Faculty Award by Beta Alpha Psi. She is also the former President of the Northeast Region of the American Accounting Association.

records.Name: Benjamin M. Cole
records.Title__c: William J. Loschert Endowed Chair of Technology Entrepreneurship; Professor
records.Education__c: Ph.D.: Strategy, Ross School of Business, University of Michigan; Master's: M.B.A. with Distinction, Ross School of Business, University of Michigan; Bachelor's: B.A., Japanese Language and Culture, Occidental College
records.Bio__c: Benjamin M. Cole, Ph.D., holds the William J. Loschert Endowed Chair of Entrepreneurship at the Gabelli School of Business at Fordham University. His professional accomplishments include: Dr. Cole uses global research settings to investigate how social factors - such as legitimacy, status, logics and media framings - influence technological innovation, regulatory oversight and economic transactions. He also holds a key interest in the disruptive nature of blockchain on existing industries; he teaches courses on blockchain and strategy. Dr. Cole is the organizer of the Blockchain Disruptor Conference and serves as an external advisor to several blockchain initiatives, where he specializes in helping them articulate and monetize their unique business models.Dr. Cole served for three years (2015-2018) as Director of the Full-time Cohort MBA and Professional M.B.A. programs at the Gabelli School. His efforts to innovate in the curricular and co-curricular space were recognized not only by the students, but also in the Gabelli School's placement in various rankings. The Cohort program gained 47 points in the U.S. News & World Report ranking (2015: 110 | 2018: 63), 37 points in the Poets & Quants ranking (2015: 99 | 2017: 62), 12 points in the Bloomberg BusinessWeek ranking (2015: 72 | 2017: 60), re-entry into the Forbes ranking (2015: unranked | 2018: 70), and a debut in The Economist ranking (2015: unranked | 2018: 92). The Professional MBA program saw a 40 point gain in the U.S. News & World Report ranking (2015: 91 | 2018: 51). Before entering academia, Dr. Cole lived in Japan for nine years, where he worked as both a translator for a Japanese textbook company and as a corporate representative for Japan's largest automaker, Toyota Motor Corporation.
